'''Polysteel''' was a substance used to construct statues. A [[Unidentified factory (Centares)|factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] at one time produced a statue of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Despot]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] made of polysteel. The statue, which depicted Xim holding a [[heatbeam]], was then put on display in an [[Soruus gladiatorial arena|arena]] on the planet [[Soruus]]. The historian [[Bleys Harand]] mentioned the polysteel statue in his text ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]'' in which [[Gender/Legends|he]] dismissed it as an inaccurate depiction of Xim.<ref name="EGTW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Polysteel was first mentioned in [[2013]] in the third instalment of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of posts on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] featuring material cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. The post was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and did not make clear the time frame of polysteels use.
